verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://sandbox0.ai/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with substantive product content, and another probe confirms markdown docs such as /docs/sandbox.md. Many docs pages are published as agent-friendly .md URLs (pause-resume.md, files.md, snapshot-restore.md, webhooks.md, and others), so an agent can be pointed at either source. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration that agents actually consume these docs effectively.
